run.change_description: Enable Flow typings on errors tests + Fix typing for Error constructor

summary.intent: Enable `@flow strict` on the error and inspect tests and widen the `GraphQLError` constructor typing so `nodes` accepts `null` like its other optional arguments (commit-7e39a12/"Fix typing for Error constructor"; the caller-supplied PR text names the same title and adds no body).
summary.issue_fit: Unavailable as an issue check: no originating issue or spec exists; the intent source is the commit message and the caller-supplied PR title. Both requirements are met.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff reviewed (5 of 5 files). Focused mocha run once at the head over the four changed test files: 27 passing. `flow check` and lint were outside the execution allowance, so the Flow typings themselves are unchecked. The supplied prior review comment (nodes should accept null) is addressed by the added `| null` in the declared constructor; no forge packet exists for a local range, so it is not carried as a prior item.

findings.title: Keep the no-stack original error in the fallback-stack test
findings.trigger: The test 'creates new stack if original error has no stack' now passes `new Error('original')`, which always has a `stack`.
findings.impact: `GraphQLError` takes the `originalError.stack` branch, so the `Error.captureStackTrace` fallback (`src/error/GraphQLError.js:201`) is no longer exercised and the test name is misleading; the base fixture `{ message: 'original' }` did exercise it.
findings.change: Build an error without a stack, for example `const original: any = new Error('original'); delete original.stack;` (or set it to `undefined`), keeping the Flow typing satisfied.

requirements.source: commit-7e39a12/"Enable Flow typings on errors tests"
requirements.evidence: `@noflow` replaced by `@flow strict` in the four test files (GraphQLError-test.js, locatedError-test.js, printError-test.js, inspect-test.js)
src/error/GraphQLError.js:25 adds `| null` to `nodes`; runtime already treats null as absent (GraphQLError.js:102-108)
